input: Any commit that modifies /moves/pawn_c7.text or /moves/bishop_c8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, so that the amnesia and greed that keep pulling these pieces off plan cannot push through an unplanned move.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/pawn_c7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_c7.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/pawn_c7.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
